description: This source file defines a static class XConvert for converting enumeration types related to drawing styles (e.g., line joins and caps) between the PdfSharp XGraphics library and platform-specific graphics APIs such as GDI+ and WPF.

classes.name: XConvert
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert XGraphics enums to platform-specific graphics enums based on compilation symbols for GDI and WPF.

methods.name: ToLineJoin
methods.description: Converts an XLineJoin enumeration value to the corresponding platform-specific LineJoin or PenLineJoin value, depending on compilation target.

methods.name: ToLineCap
methods.description: Converts an XLineCap enumeration value to the corresponding platform-specific LineCap or PenLineCap value, depending on compilation target.
